'''New Football Club "Volos"''' ({{Langx|el|Νέος Ποδοσφαιρικός Σύλλογος «Βόλος»}}), also known as '''Volos Elabet''' for sponsorship reasons,<ref>{{Cite web |last=manolo |date=2026-08-08 |title=Η Elabet ονομαστικός χορηγός της ΠΑΕ Βόλος σε μια συνεργασία-ορόσημο |url=https://www.volosfc.com/i-elabet-onomastikos-chorigos-tis-pae-volos-se-mia-synergasia-orosimo/ |access-date=2026-08-08 |website=Βολος Π.Α.Ε. |language=el}}</ref> is a Greek professional [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Volos]], [[Magnesia (regional unit)|Magnesia]], Greece.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Εγγεγραμμένα σωματεία {{!}} Ηλεκτρονικό Μητρώο Αθλητικών Σωματείων με Ειδική Αθλητική Αναγνώριση |url=https://somateia2023.gga.gov.gr/eggegramena-somateia?eggegrammeno_2023=1&kodikos_gga=%CE%9C%CE%9861&name=%CE%92%CE%9F%CE%9B%CE%9F%CE%A3+%CE%9D%CE%95%CE%9F%CE%A3+%CE%A0%CE%9F%CE%94%CE%9F%CE%A3%CE%A6%CE%91%CE%99%CE%A1%CE%99%CE%9A%CE%9F%CE%A3+%CE%A3%CE%A5%CE%9B%CE%9B%CE%9F%CE%93%CE%9F%CE%A3&omospondia=82542&athlima=%CE%A0%CE%9F%CE%94%CE%9F%CE%A3%CE%A6%CE%91%CE%99%CE%A1%CE%9F&perifereia=%CE%98%CE%95%CE%A3%CE%A3%CE%91%CE%9B%CE%99%CE%91%CE%A3&perifereiaki_enotita=%CE%9C%CE%91%CE%93%CE%9D%CE%97%CE%A3%CE%99%CE%91%CE%A3&dimos=%CE%92%CE%9F%CE%9B%CE%9F%CE%A5&op=%CE%A6%CE%AF%CE%BB%CF%84%CF%81%CE%BF |access-date=2025-07-27 |website=somateia2023.gga.gov.gr}}</ref> The club currently competes in the [[Super League Greece|Super League]], the first tier of football in Greece. Volos plays its home matches at the [[Panthessaliko Stadium]].<ref>{{cite news |url=http://www.magnesiasports.gr/index.php/football-menu/lorem-ipsum/football-league-2/item/48639-%CE%B1%CE%BB%CE%BB%CE%AC%CE%B6%CE%B5%CE%B9-%CF%8C%CF%88%CE%B7-%CF%84%CE%BF-%CE%B3%CE%AE%CF%80%CE%B5%CE%B4%CE%BF-%CF%84%CE%B7%CF%82-%CE%BD%CE%B5%CE%AC%CF%80%CE%BF%CE%BB%CE%B7%CF%82-%CE%B3%CE%B9%CE%B1-%CF%87%CE%AC%CF%81%CE%B7-%CF%84%CE%BF%CF%85-%CE%B2%CF%8C%CE%BB%CE%BF%CF%85-%CE%BD-%CF%80-%CF%83|title=Αλλάζει όψη το γήπεδο της Νεάπολης για χάρη του Βόλου Π.Σ.|publisher=www.magnesiasports.gr|date=7 July 2017 |access-date=14 November 2017}}</ref>"}}
